executionRestrictions.childBinding: Same chain/address active verified exact capabilityId/signature/actual functionAbiHash. executionScopeHash is present IFF child has empty-callback-data-v1, empty-tuple-bytes-v1, morpho-market-adapter-v1 or maple-adapter-exit-v1 and must match actual scope; corresponding decoder enforces exact empty field, fixed adapter/canonical160byte MarketParams, or fixed Maple adapter/empty ignored bytes. No other scoped child, recursive root, new permission activation or plain flattening.
executionRestrictions.authority: Independent root and every actually used child custom grants/all mode, independent global/chain/target/root/child pauses, canonical ABI/value and final live authorization checks.
executionRestrictions.budgets: Shared10-node/64KiB root+ALL expanded nodes/operations; inherited actual caller, commitments/hash recomputation and acceptance-plan equality.
executionRestrictions.context: Applicable modern OZ sources Fira/Ostium/Revert/USDai/Yelay/Aave/Ensuro use actual ordinary Context/_msgSender with suffix length0, established by retained inheritance. limitations: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory. All admitted calls are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Only Ethereum cDAI DInterest root 0x11b1c87983f881b3686f8b1171628357faa30038 is covered; exact current EIP1967 implementation 0x454007e5bae920258f25630dcd9c007ddd98c917 is upgradeable. Official published v4 frontend lists this pool; no older v3 deployment or generic fork ABI is substituted. Other Ethereum and Polygon pools, rewards, gauges and funding-token product are not admitted.

New deposits and topups pull only msg.sender DAI; deposit ownership is minted as an NFT to caller. Topup, withdrawal and rollover require current NFT owner equal msg.sender, not merely approved operator. DAI and virtual-token amounts use 18 decimals; IDs are uint64 and maturity is Unix seconds. Metadata URI is NFT display data, not executable calldata.

New maturity must be in the future and within mutable MaxDepositPeriod; observed maximum was 31,556,952 seconds, minimum new deposit 100 DAI and GlobalDepositCap=0 (unlimited), not a perpetual availability assurance. Topups must be before maturity and quote at current rate. Both simple overloads set interest minimum to zero; minimumInterestAmount is checked BEFORE subtracting the interest fee, not a net-yield guarantee.

Own withdrawal uses positive virtual-token amount clamped to remaining balance (uint256 max withdraws all). early=true only before maturity forfeits interest and deducts mutable early-withdraw fee; early=false requires maturity. Fixed interest is accounting, not guaranteed repayment: money-market shortfall can reduce the actual stablecoin payout while the virtual claim is consumed. No caller payout minimum is available.

Rollover requires an already matured own deposit, consumes its whole virtual balance and creates a new caller-owned NFT while retaining principal in the money market; fee/funder settlements can still withdraw underlying. Partial withdrawals/topups update weighted rates and reward vesting; arithmetic truncation affects amounts. No explicit claim queue is present in these methods.

Rate oracle, fee model, money-market Compound dependency and MPH vesting/minter remain mutable or external dependencies; this record does not attest all dependency runtime identities or continued availability. Direct app/docs DNS failed in this environment; lifecycle prose was retrieved through indexed primary snippets and deployment attribution through the official published repository, with this access limitation retained.

sourceSemantics.scope: Both deposit/topup/rollover overloads and own-NFT withdrawal; no funder speculation or reward/gauge surface.
sourceSemantics.maturityIsNotDeprecation: Matured positions can settle or roll over under normal current product; new ordinary deposits have positive maturity window and quote.

The requested funding payment is capped to the execution-time fixed-interest quote and only the actual amount is pulled from msg.sender under existing DAI allowance. Deposit/funding IDs are uint64. Exact source-service-bound nonproxy VaultV2 deployment; mint(uint256,address) exists in BOTH independently retrieved full ABIs AND both verified VaultV2 bodies. This is not an inferred ERC4626 method or an unconditional-revert compatibility stub.

mint accrues interest and performance/management fee shares, uses previewMint rounding assets upward, pulls asset tokens from msg.sender under the existing ERC20 allowance, mints exactly the requested shares to onBehalf and returns deposited assets. Native value must be zero; no max-assets input, deadline or minimum-output guard is provided. Conversion, rounding, fee and share-price manipulation risks remain.

The caller must pass the configured send-assets gate and onBehalf the receive-shares gate. Protocol gates/fees and the configured liquidity adapter/data are mutable dependencies. If a liquidity adapter is configured, the newly deposited assets are allocated through that already configured adapter; mint accepts no caller-selected adapter or opaque bytes. Gate/adapter errors, caps, token compatibility or asset funding can revert.

maxDeposit/maxMint/maxWithdraw/maxRedeem return zero as conservative compatibility endpoints because revert-free gate/adapter capacity cannot be guaranteed; that does not make this implemented mint body a no-op. No adapter allocation/deallocation, forceDeallocate, multicall, authority, permit, approval or signing capability is admitted.

Ethereum Fira own SisuVault Markov USDC Prime 0x50791a5ca041b9d6dd03e64e3fa0e34a376759ac only; this is not admission of a curator label on canonical Morpho. The vault fixes Fira own LendingMarket 0xc8db629192a96d6840e88a8451f17655880a2e4d. Official Fira deployment docs identify both; source and constructor immutables agree. Sourcify reports exact_match creation/runtime and no proxy for both. Root/market original full source and ABI are preserved, without claiming independent financial safety of market/oracle/token dependencies.

Deposit/mint pull only caller USDC (6 decimals) and mint vault shares (18 decimals) to the supplied receiver. Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares and pay USDC to supplied receiver; when caller differs from owner an existing share allowance is spent. No allowance, permit, role, operator or wallet authority is granted. Receiver selection is a fixed financial output, not an arbitrary executor.

Every operation first accounts for pending interest/performance-fee shares. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required assets upward, withdraw rounds required shares upward and redeem floors returned assets. Conversions use virtual assets +1 and virtual shares 10^DECIMALS_OFFSET (offset12 for USDC). None of these methods supplies a caller minimum-output, maximum-input or deadline parameter; small deposits may round shares to zero.

Deposit/mint allocate to configured Fira supplyQueue markets within caps, skipping reverting markets and reverting AllCapsReached if any requested assets cannot be allocated. Current recorded supply/withdraw queue lengths are2 and observed maxDeposit is positive; these point-in-time observations do not guarantee later capacity. Allocator/curator/owner queue, cap and parameter management are not admitted.

Withdraw/redeem source liquidity sequentially from configured withdrawQueue lending positions, bounded by supplied balances and available market liquidity, skipping failed withdrawals and reverting NotEnoughLiquidity if insufficient. These arrays are allocation priorities, not asynchronous user request queues. No claim ticket, maturity guarantee or guaranteed instant exit is provided.

Interest, losses/bad debt, utilization, collateral/oracle pricing and curator-selected market exposure affect share value. Performance fees can dilute shares via feeRecipient mints; observed fee was0 at the recorded block but is mutable. Market/oracle/IRM/USDC safety and solvency are not attested. Historical matured BT/CT/AMM series and router facets are not admitted by this vault-only scope.

Views, token transfers/approvals/permit, arbitrary multicall, skim of unaccounted tokens and governance/cap/guardian/timelock/ownership/allocator configuration are inventoried and excluded. Permissionless acceptCap/acceptGuardian/acceptTimelock are still governance activation, not investor deposit/redemption methods.

Base USDC-cbBTC MortgagePool 0xe93131620945a1273b48f57f453983d270b62dc7 is listed in official contract docs and current homepage describes this live pool. Full applicable non-proxy mortgagefiusdccbbtcupgraded source has exact_match runtime/creation records. Observed stablecoin is native Base USDC and contractCoin cbBTC; these are terms, not backing or availability proof.

deposit pulls caller USDC in native 6-decimal units and mints equal pool accounting tokens to receiver. claim and claimFor mint accrued yield accounting tokens, not immediate USDC; claimFor can only benefit its specified receiver. giveYield may move available USDC above inExitLine to mutable conversionVault and distributes buffered yield over up to 30 days using floor division. Mutable yieldOverwrite can redirect newly accrued yield; admin control is not admitted.

createContract size is cbBTC raw units (8 decimals), duration whole years from 1 through 30, maxPaymentPerMonth raw USDC, ref is rewards-coin recipient, not executor. It pulls caller cbBTC down payment, reserves existing pool cbBTC, mints an ownership NFT and fixes principal/fees from internal pool valuation, not an unconditional oracle price. Down payment is size/2 for <=12 years, size-size*4*duration/100 for 13..24 years, size/50 for 25..30, floored at 2000 cbBTC base units. Monthly maximum bounds floor-divided principal+fees/(duration*12), not total early repayment cost.

createContractByob requires enabled BYOB, pulls size plus down payment cbBTC from caller, fixes 18%-per-year fee calculation from checked Chainlink price and mints pool accounting tokens to caller, not USDC. Oracle checks require positive answer, <=24h age, answeredInRound and Base sequencer up with >=1h grace. BYOB was observed enabled, not a continuing guarantee.

payDownContract pulls caller USDC against a designated loan scheduled outstanding amount; it does not require NFT ownership and cannot redirect collateral or grant loan control. Only currently accrued scheduled outstanding can be paid this way. Fee fraction floors, 10% of fees mints protocol accounting tokens and remainder enters yield buffer. openDebt may revert on unsigned subtraction when prepaid ahead of schedule; admission supplies no workaround or successful-payment promise.

finishContract and earlyRepayContractInFull require caller NFT ownership. finish requires all base+fee paid, transfers NFT to pool custody and returns recorded cbBTC to caller. Early repayment pulls remaining principal plus mutable earlyrepayMultiplier percent (admin setter caps at 15), marks debt paid and invokes finish. No caller maximum early fee or deadline argument exists; NFT transfer allowance must already exist independently.

fromLineToWallet only debits caller existing mySizeWaitingForExit and returns USDC if available. Queue creation burnToGetOutInLine is ADMIN_ROLE-only and excluded, so this is not a complete permissionless redemption path. Token transfers/permits/roles/admin, arbitrary multicall, conversion-vault bookkeeping and third-party default enforcement are excluded. Missed-payment default can forfeit reserved collateral; pricing, defaults and conversion-vault behavior remain protocol risks.

UUPS proxy 0x99c2901d2883f8d295a989544f118e31ec21823e currently resolves to 0xd2ca9a959268d2ec1f951a2f1691966f38a5a433. Root is Sourcify exact_match; current implementation is Sourcify match, NOT exact_match. Owner can upgrade and change manager, fee recipient and fees; manager trades pooled assets. Fixed Uniswap pool and token dependencies are not independently safety-attested.

Amounts are raw units: share decimals observed 18 and both assets 18. deposit requests an exact positive share amount, not exact assets: it rounds position liquidity and idle-asset contributions up, pays entry fees rounded up, and checks both asset maxima including fees. Caller funds all transfers and pool mint callbacks; shares mint only to caller. No native ETH wrapping, AutoConvert, cross-chain or aggregator execution is admitted.

withdraw debits only caller shares: rounded-up exit-fee shares go to the fee recipient; remaining shares are burned. Idle balances and removed liquidity are pro rata rounded down; both post-fee asset minima apply, and both ERC20 assets return to caller. No queue or delayed claim is created; proportional strategy losses are borne by shares. No deadline parameter exists for either method.

Both methods accrue management fees as new shares rounded up and collect pool swap fees subject to rounded-up performance fees. Current observed config has entryFee=0, exitFee=2000, performanceFee=150000, managementFee=15000 with denominator 1000000 (0%, 0.2%, 15%, 1.5% annual respectively); configuration can change. Fee recipient is exempt from entry/exit fees. Source management-fee denominator falls back to 1 when fee-time accrual exceeds a year-scaled denominator, so long inactivity can severely dilute shares.

Arbitrum native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 is immutable asset with6 decimals; rlUSDC lender shares also use6 decimals. Loan tokenId is a fixed-manager Uniswap V3 NFT and debt shares are separate loan-accounting units; neither is lender rlUSDC or raw ETH.

Plain deposit/mint pull USDC atomically from msg.sender using existing allowance to V3Vault and mint rlUSDC to receiver; they pass empty permitData internally. Permit2 overloads and all signature authorization entries are excluded. No standalone prefunding capability.

Conversions update accrued interest first. Deposit floors shares, mint rounds required USDC up; redeem floors USDC, withdraw rounds shares up. In this exact V3Vault implementation a withdrawal/redeem request exceeding owner share balance is clipped to that balance and recalculates assets, so requested exact assets may not be delivered. No caller minimum output, maximum input or deadline.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares; a different msg.sender requires pre-existing share allowance from owner. USDC goes to caller-chosen receiver. Exits require idle USDC and revert InsufficientLiquidity when insufficient; no withdrawal queue or fixed exit delay is provided.

Owner or emergencyAdmin can change global and daily lending/debt limits; zero or restrictive lending limits can block entry. Daily lending limit resets on UTC day number and exits replenish it. No current limits or perpetual unpaused availability are attested; this direct source has no separate lender pause flag.

Lenders fund loans against allowed Uniswap V3 LP NFT collateral, subject to oracle values, collateral/debt limits, minimum loan sizes, health checks and liquidations. Ordinary collateral deposit, borrowing, no-permit repayment, liquidity/fee withdrawal and zero-debt NFT removal are separately admitted; removal requires runtime-enforced empty callback bytes. Uncovered liquidation shortfalls can lower lending exchange rate pro rata. Signature-bearing liquidation, transformer authority, arbitrary multicall and direct NFT callback entrypoints remain excluded.

ABI functions do not establish website, legal, jurisdictional or account eligibility; any applicable protocol and independent policy restrictions remain binding. No KYC clearance or asset-safety assertion.

limitations: Static source/deployment/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, crediting, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory. Native value is permitted only by the payable depositNative fragment; all other selected calls require zero value.

Current Arbitrum core proxy 0x6cae28b3d09d8f8fc74ccd496ac986fc84c0c24e resolves to 0x555d00bbb3c8c4dadd698aed2e5cfdc1d37d7b29; Vault proxy 0x3f37c7d8e61c000085aac0515775b06a3412f36b resolves to 0xe6267a0564c577b16aded919bba2eaa3d484d838. EIP1967 slots agree with Sourcify resolution. Implementation source grades are match/match, not exact_match; complete originals are retained. Repository current deployment file links roots but lists an older core implementation, so that old implementation is not used.

Vault is Contango financial cashflow accounting: per-token accountBalances and totalBalance back financial-margin credits consumed/returned by Contango. It is not a yield vault or bare transfer helper. deposit uses account as payer/beneficiary and requires caller==account or preexisting CONTANGO_ROLE; depositTo pays from msg.sender for a beneficiary. No role/approval/delegation is granted.

Vault deposits credit the requested positive amount, consuming any existing unaccounted token balance before pulling only the shortfall from payer. Do not use a separate raw-prefunding/public-mint workaround or assume transferred amount always equals credited amount. Token must be operator-supported; fee-on-transfer/rebasing or inconsistent balance behavior is not normalized or financially attested. Units are the chosen token raw decimals; no shares, exchange-rate rounding, source fee or slippage minimum.

depositNative wraps exactly positive msg.value into immutable Arbitrum WETH 0x82af49447d8a07e3bd95bd0d56f35241523fbab1 (18 decimals) then credits account. It requires caller==account or existing CONTANGO_ROLE. No token transfer approval is needed for native wrapping; the payable call value must equal intended deposited wei.

withdraw and withdrawNative debit only account cash-ledger balance, and require caller==account or preexisting CONTANGO_ROLE. Positive amount and sufficient ledger balance required; chosen nonzero to receives tokens or unwrapped ETH. Ledger funds already deployed into money-market positions are not free cash; this is not position debt repayment, collateral removal or guaranteed liquidity. Native payout executes an empty-data ETH transfer, not caller-programmable calldata.

claimRewards checks current NFT owner or existing NFT-wide approved/trusted Contango operator; after NFT burn only lastOwner may call. to is reward beneficiary, not executable payload. It invokes fixed moneyMarket(positionId).claimRewards with instrument base/quote and recipient; no caller bytes, routers, permit or wallet authority. Underlying reward token set/amount, eligibility, rounding and availability depend on the configured money market; reward payout is not guaranteed.

Core claimRewards is gated by core pause; observed paused was false. Vault inherits a pause query but its selected methods have no pause modifier; paused() does not establish a pause gate for those methods. Proxy upgrades, token-support admin and CONTANGO_ROLE can change access/behavior. NFT, position-factory, money-market/rewards and token dependency runtime/safety attestation is not complete.

trade/tradeOnBehalfOf are wholly excluded because ExecutionParams allow caller router/spender/swapBytes/flash-provider choices. No empty-bytes special case, generic multicall, callbacks, donatePosition ownership mutation, staking, API signing or new execution model is admitted. Selected methods provide only finite current ledger funding/withdrawal and existing-position reward claim, not a complete leveraged-position workflow.

sourceSemantics.custody: Explicit token-account ledger consumed by Contango; CONTANGO_ROLE preexisting can withdraw for accounts. Own exit bounded to remaining cash, not encumbered positions.
sourceSemantics.rewards: Fixed positionFactory-selected moneyMarket claim interface; current selected root has no arbitrary payload. Dependency financial safety/runtime attestation remains unresolved and not prerequisite.

Vault is Contango financial cashflow accounting: per-token accountBalances and totalBalance back financial-margin credits consumed/returned by Contango. It is not a yield vault or bare transfer helper. deposit uses account as payer/beneficiary and requires caller==account or preexisting CONTANGO_ROLE; depositTo pays from msg.sender for a beneficiary. No role/approval/delegation is granted.

Vault deposits credit the requested positive amount, consuming any existing unaccounted token balance before pulling only the shortfall from payer. Do not use a separate raw-prefunding/public-mint workaround or assume transferred amount always equals credited amount. Token must be operator-supported; fee-on-transfer/rebasing or inconsistent balance behavior is not normalized or financially attested. Units are the chosen token raw decimals; no shares, exchange-rate rounding, source fee or slippage minimum.

depositNative wraps exactly positive msg.value into immutable Arbitrum WETH 0x82af49447d8a07e3bd95bd0d56f35241523fbab1 (18 decimals) then credits account. It requires caller==account or existing CONTANGO_ROLE. No token transfer approval is needed for native wrapping; the payable call value must equal intended deposited wei.

withdraw and withdrawNative debit only account cash-ledger balance, and require caller==account or preexisting CONTANGO_ROLE. Positive amount and sufficient ledger balance required; chosen nonzero to receives tokens or unwrapped ETH. Ledger funds already deployed into money-market positions are not free cash; this is not position debt repayment, collateral removal or guaranteed liquidity. Native payout executes an empty-data ETH transfer, not caller-programmable calldata.

claimRewards checks current NFT owner or existing NFT-wide approved/trusted Contango operator; after NFT burn only lastOwner may call. to is reward beneficiary, not executable payload. It invokes fixed moneyMarket(positionId).claimRewards with instrument base/quote and recipient; no caller bytes, routers, permit or wallet authority. Underlying reward token set/amount, eligibility, rounding and availability depend on the configured money market; reward payout is not guaranteed.

Core claimRewards is gated by core pause; observed paused was false. Vault inherits a pause query but its selected methods have no pause modifier; paused() does not establish a pause gate for those methods. Proxy upgrades, token-support admin and CONTANGO_ROLE can change access/behavior. NFT, position-factory, money-market/rewards and token dependency runtime/safety attestation is not complete.

trade/tradeOnBehalfOf are wholly excluded because ExecutionParams allow caller router/spender/swapBytes/flash-provider choices. No empty-bytes special case, generic multicall, callbacks, donatePosition ownership mutation, staking, API signing or new execution model is admitted. Selected methods provide only finite current ledger funding/withdrawal and existing-position reward claim, not a complete leveraged-position workflow.

limitations: Only the Ethereum WETH PLP immutable clone is admitted; no retired close-only market, RiskEngine, pool dispatch, trading, vault management, callback or multicall is admitted.

Request deposits transfer caller WETH (18 decimals) with prior allowance to this vault; they queue assets and do not immediately mint shares. Withdrawal request amounts are share units, not raw WETH, and burn the caller virtual shares while reserving a cost basis.

Manager fulfillment is asynchronous, partial and dependent on strategy liquidity and accountant NAV. No maximum waiting time, caller deadline, min shares or min WETH bound exists; floor rounding and unfulfilled remainders affect results.

executeDeposit/executeWithdrawal can be called for another user, but shares/WETH are credited to that fixed user, never a caller-selected payout target. Supply changes at fulfillment, not execution; rolling remainders require subsequent epoch executions.

cancelDeposit() only cancels the caller current unfulfilled epoch; earlier remainders must be advanced with executeDeposit. Withdrawal cancellation is manager-only and excluded. Manager can initiate withdrawals and enable redeposit; owner can change manager, accountant and fee wallet.

optOutOfRedeposit only updates caller queue flag for the supplied epoch. A permissionless executeWithdrawal may execute a manager-created redeposit before the user opts out; the catalog does not enforce ordering.

Creation and observed explorer read configuration bind WETH and zero performance fee. Underlying token and performanceFeeBps have no setters in this implementation. Current manager/owner differ from initialization and must not be inferred from constructor state.

Manager has arbitrary vault call authority; accountant can be replaced by owner and its NAV controls fulfillment pricing. Strategy risk, loss and cash constraints remain. Source has no ordinary user KYC or pause modifier; app eligibility/jurisdiction remains independent.

Static ABI/source and explorer configuration evidence is not a block-pinned runtime identity, current allocation, liquidity, execution, backing or financial-safety guarantee; no automatic financial validation, transaction sending or workflow assurance is added.

sourceSemantics.asset: WETH 18 decimals; shares have underlying decimals but price differs from asset units. All selected functions nonpayable.
sourceSemantics.requestDeposit: Adds uint128 assets to caller current deposit queue and aggregate; SafeTransferFrom underlying caller -> vault.
sourceSemantics.requestWithdrawal: Caller only; proportionately removes userBasis, enqueues amount+basis, burns virtual shares. Zero user share balance divides by zero; caller must use an owned balance.
sourceSemantics.cancelDeposit: No-arg ordinary function only: zeros current caller deposit queue, decreases aggregate with saturating floor, transfers underlying back to caller; overloaded address form is manager-only.
sourceSemantics.executeDeposit: Permissionless fixed user/epoch execution after epoch < depositEpoch. Floor pro-rata fulfilled assets then floor shares, mint virtual user balance and add basis; remainder rolls epoch+1. Manager already added minted supply at fulfillment.
sourceSemantics.executeWithdrawal: Permissionless fixed user/epoch execution after epoch < withdrawalEpoch. Floor pro-rata fulfilled shares/assets/basis; reserve accounting and performance fee on positive profit, then send underlying to user or queue current deposit if manager redeposit flag persisted; leftover rolls epoch+1.
sourceSemantics.optOutOfRedeposit: Only msg.sender withdrawal queue flag for selected epoch set false; no arbitrary target call.
sourceSemantics.fulfillment: Manager-only excluded fulfillment uses owner-replaceable accountant.computeNAV plus 1 asset, less queued deposits and withdrawal reserves. Initial virtual supply 1,000,000; Math.mulDiv floors. No user min-return guard.
sourceSemantics.authority: Owner controls manager/accountant/fee wallet. Manager may call arbitrary targets with vault assets and trigger requestWithdrawalFrom for any user/redeposit. No claim that source-level privilege implies financial safety.
sourceSemantics.fee: Performance fee immutable-after-initialize in this ABI, 0 in creation and explorer read; generic source charges max(assets-basis,0)*bps/10000 to fee wallet on withdrawal.
sourceSemantics.eligibility: No selected source modifier implements allowlist/KYC/pause; source inventory does not override legal/frontend eligibility.

lifecycleEvidence.excerpt: WETH PLP Vault: deposited WETH allocated into Panoptic lending markets and liquidity/market making strategies. Community vaults do not charge performance fees.
lifecycleEvidence.snapshot: # Vaults Panoptic vaults span the risk-return spectrum, offering strategies for both conservative depositors and higher-risk yield seekers. Vaults may be curated by Panoptic or by external managers. Panoptic Community Vaults provide onchain yield with zero performance fees. External curators may deploy custom strategies and charge performance fees. ## Community Vaults Panoptic’s community vaults do not charge performance fees and are designed to provide accessible, onchain yield strategies. New vaults and expanded caps will roll out every few weeks after launch. Panoptic will initially launch with two community vaults. ![Panoptic vaults comparison](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/panoptic-vaults-comparison-f5b121ec1f00833e530556bec7aa2a55.png) ### USDC Unicorn Vault Deposited USDC is allocated into Panoptic’s underlying lending markets, beginning with the ETH/USDC market and expanding to additional markets like BTC/USDC over time. The strategy also runs systematic, delta-neutral gamma scalping designed to buy low and sell high. ![USDC Unicorn Vault animation](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/usdc-unicorn-vault-1676f5b572c5481d5091fa8a66c7517b.gif) ![USDC Unicorn Vault details](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/unicorn-vault-info-3ca0a86bdfc498f28002f77862265723.png) ### WETH PLP Vault Deposited WETH is allocated into Panoptic’s underlying lending markets, beginning with the ETH/USDC market at launch. The vault provides liquidity to Panoptic through lending and market making strategies, and accrues platform fees. ![WETH PLP Vault animation](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/weth-plp-vault-a49de4dc91fb3f802b4b8e650f394fed.gif) ![WETH PLP Vault details](https://panoptic.xyz/assets/images/plp-vault-info-080965f9a5fb0070871972fd6537885e.png) ## Curated Vaults Anyone can create a vault using Panoptic’s vault infrastructure. Curated vaults may run any strategy — including lending or options trading — and may charge performance fees to depositors.

Ethereum Brickken factory id 54 investor escrow only. Current getImplementation() and beacon implementation() both resolve to 0x4459432f1626cc4de0e0a004e74ff282ae9c4a6f. Beacon 0xe2f8f2910d923e660a4a526f7c08ef3ddd7a713d is effective because the EIP1967 implementation override slot is zero. getTokens(index,onBehalfOf) settles the recorded investor, not an arbitrary receiver: successful offering claims mint precisely that investor's recorded STO amount; rollback refunds precisely that investor's recorded payment-token amount. Any caller must already be whitelisted on the related token; this catalog neither creates KYC approval nor grants a role.

Success means raisedAmount >= softCap; minting additionally requires issuer withdrawal or nonzero partial withdrawal. Refund requires an explicit ROLLBACK status. This is a finite primary subscription receipt/refund, not redemption of a backing asset or a sell order. Caller cannot change the recorded recipient or amount; passing another investor only settles to that investor.

Index and amounts are protocol accounting units: the chosen BHC token uses 18 decimals; successful claims mint stored amountInSTO without repricing. Refunds use paymentTokensToRefund[index] and stored amountInPaymentToken in that token's native decimals, not necessarily the original token supplied for a swap. Claim flags are set before mint/transfer. No direct claim fee is deducted by getTokens; issuer success fees and funding/configuration changes affect the offering lifecycle.

Current issuance 5 is WITHDRAWN with raisedAmount at hardCap and an end date of 2026-10-19; ordinary receipt settlement remains exposed. buyToken is deliberately excluded for this finite offering because its date has ended and cap is reached. This is not a shutdown or recovery deployment: official current production docs retain ordinary investor investment and claim operations, and factory id 54 settled offerings in October 2026.

Related token, role registry, payment asset, oracle/swap manager and issuer accounting/legal records are dependencies, not independently runtime/safety/backing-attested here. Issuer controls offchain reporting, offering parameters and settlement; tokens can carry transfer restrictions/confiscation. No asset ownership, legal eligibility, backing or payout guarantee is made.

Blockscout current implementation metadata identifies StakedUSDai implementation. abiEvidence.limitation: Reported Sourcify match (not exact_match) for implementation. Immutable USDai binding and linked library addresses are source-service onchain transformation evidence, not a fresh runtime or storage attestation.

Arbitrum hub sUSDai TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0x0B2b2B2076d95dda7817e785989fE353fe955ef9; Blockscout reports implementation 0x4637193852dF85b7Ac05DD052B187460D81551f6. Sourcify proxyResolution incorrectly/insufficiently reports isProxy false despite proxy compilation; binding uses Blockscout implementation metadata, not that negative result.

Underlying asset is Arbitrum USDai; Ethereum/Base/Plasma token deployments are OFT representations and are not user vault targets here. Deposits mint sUSDai at optimistic valuation; direct deposit/mint variants have no caller slippage bound. Overloads with minShares/maxAmount add explicit price limits; referral overload only records a referral code.

requestRedeem burns shares immediately into an asynchronous FIFO request for controller; caller must be owner or an already approved operator. Minimum request is 1e18 shares and at most 50 active requests per controller. No cancel-request function exists in the reviewed ABI.

withdraw/redeem are claim methods against already serviced controller requests, not instant unstaking. Caller must be controller or existing operator; servicing is STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE-only, cash-constrained and epoch-based, with potential partial fulfillment and multi-epoch delay. Request shares do not guarantee prompt USDai liquidity.

Pause and USDai blacklist restrictions apply; controller eligibility is checked explicitly and underlying transfers/share _update remain subject to blacklist checks. Deposits/mints are ordinary user calls, but do not bypass USDai legal, sanctions or transfer restrictions. No operator grants, permit, bridge mint/burn, multicall or loan callbacks admitted.

sourceSemantics.staking: Three deposit overloads and two user mint overloads transfer USDai and mint sUSDai using real implementation _deposit/_mint. minShares/maxAmount overloads protect conversion; referral merely logs event. _update checks msg.sender/from/to blacklist.
sourceSemantics.redemption: requestRedeem(shares,controller,owner) burns sUSDai, authenticates owner or existing operator, checks controller blacklist, queues request via bound RedemptionLogic library. Request minimum 1e18 shares and max 50 active per controller. Thirty-day global epochs derive from immutable genesis; privileged STRATEGY_ADMIN_ROLE serviceRedemptions services available cash FIFO. withdraw/redeem consume serviced controller requests, not wallet shares or immediate generic ERC4626 exits.
sourceSemantics.disabledPreviews: previewWithdraw and previewRedeem unconditionally revert DisabledImplementation. They remain in complete ABI but are excluded.
sourceSemantics.ownership: No generic share allowance is substituted for _validateOperator: caller must equal account or already be in isOperator mapping. setOperator is retained but unadmitted authorization management.
sourceSemantics.scope: No USDai base mint/redeem, bridge OFT, adapter, arbitrary multicall, loan callbacks, strategy manager or loan markets admitted.

lifecycleEvidence.decision: Admit actual Arbitrum sUSDai vault ordinary deposits and asynchronous redemption request/claim methods. Official Oct 2 2026 recap describes funded GPU loans, sUSDai distribution and ongoing GLX development; current docs explain cash-constrained FIFO epochs. No retirement or exit-only context identified in reviewed sources.
lifecycleEvidence.metrics: Official $659M+ TVL is protocol-level marketing, not claimed vault TVL or DAU. No numeric activity metric used for admission.

targets.dispatchAndGradeQualification: Custom mutable selector-facet router, not one immutable implementation. Shell YelayLiteVault is Proxy and Multicall; root selector registered to self. Observed child selectors route to FundsFacet0xce0dE4c16cD7734202939BbeB03905cB750c6901; root runtime exact_match, FundsFacet Sourcify absence and independent explorer qualifications remain as in original book. Source service isProxy:false does NOT establish immutability. Owner-controlled routes/configured strategies/YieldExtractor can change. Root OZ context is ordinary Context, zero suffix.

Sourcify isProxy:false is detector output, not a non-proxy claim. Dated selectorToFacet reads bind every reviewed ABI function to current route or absent mapping.

Ethereum YelayLiteVault 0x615989F57f6da73C3a1f96a347536941D88e7E0A routes selectors via owner-controlled mapping, not one EIP1967 implementation. Current observed deposit/redeem/migratePosition routes resolve to FundsFacet 0xce0dE4c16cD7734202939BbeB03905cB750c6901 at recorded block. Sourcify does not detect the custom selector routing and reports this custom-router deployment as isProxy:false; verified vault source establishes delegate routing. Future selector upgrades can change behavior.

Underlying getter at the recorded block returned Ethereum 6-decimal USDC 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. Assets and ERC1155 share amounts are raw units, not human currency amounts or ordinary ERC4626 ERC20 shares. Supply spans project IDs; deposit requires USDC allowance to the vault and an active client project ID; shares are minted to explicit receiver.

Deposit and redeem accrue all positive strategy interest as new project-0 yield shares held by configured YieldExtractor. User project shares principally represent capital; separately distributed yield claims, Merkle proofs and transform/claim paths are not admitted here. Project/client fee distribution is external to this bounded vault-function inventory, not guaranteed automatic compounding to this caller.

Conversion floors assets*totalSupply/totalAssets (initial deposit uses 1:1 units); no min shares, min assets, max loss or deadline argument protects the transaction. A small deposit can mint zero shares. Deposits try configured deposit-queue strategy adapters by delegatecall with fixed deposit(assets,supplement); if none succeeds, underlying is held internally. Callers cannot provide the adapter, supplement or arbitrary payload in admitted functions.

Redeem burns only msg.sender project shares, with no delegated owner argument or operator allowance path; receiver may differ. It computes assets after fee accrual, requires assets > 10 raw underlying units, and tries configured withdrawal queue. WITHDRAW_MARGIN=10 permits up to 10 raw units of shortfall/normalization; insufficient internal funds reverts. Strategy liquidity, queues and valuation can delay or prevent cash exit even though no user cooldown/withdrawal queue is encoded.

migratePosition burns caller shares and mints equal shares in a different active project under the same client; both IDs must be active and different. It does not move cash or bridge chains. Receiver ERC1155 hooks may revert deposits/migrations. No arbitrary multicall, swap, management/role, approval, token-transfer callback or reward-maintenance entry is admitted.

Each user function checks its own selector pause flag; authority can pause individual calls. Strategies/adapters, queues, client/project activation, role holders, YieldExtractor and selector mappings remain mutable. Official current SDK setup says new client activations are not being accepted; this admission covers ordinary existing active-project vault interactions, not new onboarding or legal eligibility.

Yelay is counted once, including former Spool continuity; no legacy Spool vault/deployment is admitted. Current website offers live yield infrastructure and current docs/repository map this vault. No TVL, usage, APY, performance or whole-workflow assurance is made.

deposit/depositTo pull caller funds into an internal lending-collateral ledger; deposit credits caller, depositTo credits its nonzero beneficiary without granting withdrawal rights over another user. withdraw operates only on msg.sender collateral and pays msg.sender, not a caller-selected owner/recipient. Currency is a registered bytes32 key and amounts use that currency token native units, not fixed 18 decimals.

For a currency configured as native wrapped token, deposit native value must equal amount and is wrapped into custody; all other currencies require zero native value and existing ERC20 allowance. withdraw is nonpayable, requires zero native value and unwraps configured native collateral before paying caller. Deposits require active nonterminated market, unpaused vault, registered currency, and allowed per-user deposited-currency count. They call currency-specific cleanUpFunds before recording custody. Withdrawals require unpaused vault and no outstanding required redemption, clean up funds, and clamp payout to the calculated withdrawable collateral; actual payout may be smaller than requested and has no minimum-output parameter. Aggregate deposit insolvency or transfer failure reverts.

Withdrawable collateral depends on current debts, orders, maturity/auto-roll accounting, currency prices, haircuts and liquidation configuration; deposited collateral can be liquidated. No selected body directly charges a deposit/withdrawal fee, but linked financial accounting and cleanup may incorporate lending fees and rounded risk conversions. Market controllers, resolver cache, linked DepositManagementLogic, registered tokens, wrapped-native behavior and owner/operator settings remain dependencies; not every dependency runtime was independently attested. This selection provides collateral custody only, not order entry, complete lending or all settlement paths.

No slippage/deadline parameters exist; share value, slashing, fees, donation/inflation and rounding risk remain. Roles, ownership, permit, migrate and raw push/pull are excluded.

Vault is Contango financial cashflow accounting: per-token accountBalances and totalBalance back financial-margin credits consumed/returned by Contango. It is not a yield vault or bare transfer helper. deposit uses account as payer/beneficiary and requires caller==account or preexisting CONTANGO_ROLE; depositTo pays from msg.sender for a beneficiary. No role/approval/delegation is granted.

Vault deposits credit the requested positive amount, consuming any existing unaccounted token balance before pulling only the shortfall from payer. Do not use a separate raw-prefunding/public-mint workaround or assume transferred amount always equals credited amount. Token must be operator-supported; fee-on-transfer/rebasing or inconsistent balance behavior is not normalized or financially attested. Units are the chosen token raw decimals; no shares, exchange-rate rounding, source fee or slippage minimum.

depositNative wraps exactly positive msg.value into immutable Arbitrum WETH 0x82af49447d8a07e3bd95bd0d56f35241523fbab1 (18 decimals) then credits account. It requires caller==account or existing CONTANGO_ROLE. No token transfer approval is needed for native wrapping; the payable call value must equal intended deposited wei.

withdraw and withdrawNative debit only account cash-ledger balance, and require caller==account or preexisting CONTANGO_ROLE. Positive amount and sufficient ledger balance required; chosen nonzero to receives tokens or unwrapped ETH. Ledger funds already deployed into money-market positions are not free cash; this is not position debt repayment, collateral removal or guaranteed liquidity. Native payout executes an empty-data ETH transfer, not caller-programmable calldata.

claimRewards checks current NFT owner or existing NFT-wide approved/trusted Contango operator; after NFT burn only lastOwner may call. to is reward beneficiary, not executable payload. It invokes fixed moneyMarket(positionId).claimRewards with instrument base/quote and recipient; no caller bytes, routers, permit or wallet authority. Underlying reward token set/amount, eligibility, rounding and availability depend on the configured money market; reward payout is not guaranteed.

Core claimRewards is gated by core pause; observed paused was false. Vault inherits a pause query but its selected methods have no pause modifier; paused() does not establish a pause gate for those methods. Proxy upgrades, token-support admin and CONTANGO_ROLE can change access/behavior. NFT, position-factory, money-market/rewards and token dependency runtime/safety attestation is not complete.

Base USDC-cbBTC MortgagePool 0xe93131620945a1273b48f57f453983d270b62dc7 is listed in official contract docs and current homepage describes this live pool. Full applicable non-proxy mortgagefiusdccbbtcupgraded source has exact_match runtime/creation records. Observed stablecoin is native Base USDC and contractCoin cbBTC; these are terms, not backing or availability proof.

deposit pulls caller USDC in native 6-decimal units and mints equal pool accounting tokens to receiver. claim and claimFor mint accrued yield accounting tokens, not immediate USDC; claimFor can only benefit its specified receiver. giveYield may move available USDC above inExitLine to mutable conversionVault and distributes buffered yield over up to 30 days using floor division. Mutable yieldOverwrite can redirect newly accrued yield; admin control is not admitted.

createContract size is cbBTC raw units (8 decimals), duration whole years from 1 through 30, maxPaymentPerMonth raw USDC, ref is rewards-coin recipient, not executor. It pulls caller cbBTC down payment, reserves existing pool cbBTC, mints an ownership NFT and fixes principal/fees from internal pool valuation, not an unconditional oracle price. Down payment is size/2 for <=12 years, size-size*4*duration/100 for 13..24 years, size/50 for 25..30, floored at 2000 cbBTC base units. Monthly maximum bounds floor-divided principal+fees/(duration*12), not total early repayment cost.

createContractByob requires enabled BYOB, pulls size plus down payment cbBTC from caller, fixes 18%-per-year fee calculation from checked Chainlink price and mints pool accounting tokens to caller, not USDC. Oracle checks require positive answer, <=24h age, answeredInRound and Base sequencer up with >=1h grace. BYOB was observed enabled, not a continuing guarantee.

payDownContract pulls caller USDC against a designated loan scheduled outstanding amount; it does not require NFT ownership and cannot redirect collateral or grant loan control. Only currently accrued scheduled outstanding can be paid this way. Fee fraction floors, 10% of fees mints protocol accounting tokens and remainder enters yield buffer. openDebt may revert on unsigned subtraction when prepaid ahead of schedule; admission supplies no workaround or successful-payment promise.

finishContract and earlyRepayContractInFull require caller NFT ownership. finish requires all base+fee paid, transfers NFT to pool custody and returns recorded cbBTC to caller. Early repayment pulls remaining principal plus mutable earlyrepayMultiplier percent (admin setter caps at 15), marks debt paid and invokes finish. No caller maximum early fee or deadline argument exists; NFT transfer allowance must already exist independently.

fromLineToWallet only debits caller existing mySizeWaitingForExit and returns USDC if available. Queue creation burnToGetOutInLine is ADMIN_ROLE-only and excluded, so this is not a complete permissionless redemption path. Token transfers/permits/roles/admin, arbitrary multicall, conversion-vault bookkeeping are excluded. Missed-payment default can forfeit reserved collateral; pricing, defaults and conversion-vault behavior remain protocol risks.

Source-defined defaultContract(uint256) third-party delinquency/forfeiture enforcement is now separately admitted; borrower collateral can be forfeited under the contract default test. limitations: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, funding, backing, liquidity, successful execution, financial safety, legal eligibility or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory; zero native value required.

Ethereum BTCDStaking 0x3bc801419479865b24b4d32fab0bf64638abbd5f and VaultMinting 0xc60f6892973934c93ade915d5c249f10d4ece7b4 are direct non-proxy contracts, each Sourcify runtime/creation exact_match. Full own compilation sources and ABI are retained, not a generic ERC4626 ABI. Primary documentation explicitly lists both; current primary resources include October2026 product posts.

sBTCD deposit/mint pull caller BTCD and issue shares to receiver; deposit floors shares and mint rounds assets up. Both BTCD and sBTCD use18 decimals. Exchange rate uses totalAssets excluding linearly unvested rewards and virtual +1 assets/shares. Positive assets/shares and nonzero totalSupply of at least1e18 shares are required; no user minimum shares or maximum assets parameter exists.

sBTCD withdraw/redeem pay receiver and burn owner shares; when owner differs from caller an existing share allowance is spent, never created here. Withdraw rounds shares up and redeem floors assets. Point-in-time cooldownDuration was0, enabling these methods; cooldownAssets/cooldownShares currently structurally disabled and excluded. unstake claims only caller preexisting silo balance after its deadline, or immediately when cooldown=0; it neither starts a cooldown nor grants another account authority.

Administrators can change cooldown up to90days and reward vesting up to90days, blacklist accounts, redistribute fully restricted balances, and rescue certain funds. Observed vestingPeriod=86400seconds. Soft restrictions block caller/receiver deposits, full restrictions can block transfers/exits. Ordinary claim is not a promise of liquidity or absence of loss; no blacklist, role, reward-distribution, token approval/transfer/permit or admin capability is granted.

VaultMinting mintWBTC/mintUSDC/mint pull only caller collateral, return BTCD to a pre-whitelisted recipient, and enforce caller minimum BTCD output. burnWBTC/burnUSDC/burn burn caller BTCD via configured MintingProxy and pay only whitelisted recipient; existing token permissions and eligibility may be required but none are granted here. WBTC8, USDC6, BTCD18 decimals. Recipient address is fixed financial output, never arbitrary executable calldata.

VaultMinting quotes depend on mutable BTCD/USD feed, WBTC/BTC and BTC/USD feeds with positive/completeness/staleness checks; USDC converts through Sky LitePSM and sUSDS. Fees are mutable basis points, single-leg fee differs from matched dual-leg fee. mulDiv floors input/output conversions, matched mint portion floors, blended burn fee rounds up; USDS/USDC dust is recycled with possible sub-share dust loss. Balanced burn output follows current WBTC/sUSDS collateral proportions, not guaranteed50/50 payout.

VaultMinting source checks pause, nonzero inputs, available collateral and per-block capacities. Point-in-time paused=false and mint/redeem limits were positive; not continuing availability. Minimum output checks apply after actual USDC redemption; burn has separate WBTC and USDC minima. No caller deadline parameter. MintProxy, owner-set feeds, collateral manager and custody operations are dependencies/privileges, not admitted as extra targets. Their independent runtime or financial safety is not attested; RFQ/strategy execution and IPOR-curated vaults are outside this inventory.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity 0.8.18;

/**
 * @title Pool Events
 */
interface IPoolEvents {

    /*********************/
    /*** Lender events ***/
    /*********************/

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when lender adds quote token to the pool.
     *  @param  lender    Recipient that added quote tokens.
     *  @param  index     Index at which quote tokens were added.
     *  @param  amount    Amount of quote tokens added to the pool (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lpAwarded Amount of `LP` awarded for the deposit (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lup       `LUP` calculated after deposit.
     */
    event AddQuoteToken(
        address indexed lender,
        uint256 indexed index,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 lpAwarded,
        uint256 lup
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when lender moves quote token from a bucket price to another.
     *  @param  lender         Recipient that moved quote tokens.
     *  @param  from           Price bucket from which quote tokens were moved.
     *  @param  to             Price bucket where quote tokens were moved.
     *  @param  amount         Amount of quote tokens moved (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lpRedeemedFrom Amount of `LP` removed from the `from` bucket (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lpAwardedTo    Amount of `LP` credited to the `to` bucket (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lup            `LUP` calculated after removal.
     */
    event MoveQuoteToken(
        address indexed lender,
        uint256 indexed from,
        uint256 indexed to,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 lpRedeemedFrom,
        uint256 lpAwardedTo,
        uint256 lup
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when lender removes quote token from the pool.
     *  @param  lender     Recipient that removed quote tokens.
     *  @param  index      Index at which quote tokens were removed.
     *  @param  amount     Amount of quote tokens removed from the pool (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lpRedeemed Amount of `LP` exchanged for quote token (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lup        `LUP` calculated after removal.
     */
    event RemoveQuoteToken(
        address indexed lender,
        uint256 indexed index,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 lpRedeemed,
        uint256 lup
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when lender claims collateral from a bucket.
     *  @param  claimer    Recipient that claimed collateral.
     *  @param  index      Index at which collateral was claimed.
     *  @param  amount     The amount of collateral (`WAD` precision for `ERC20` pools, number of `NFT` tokens for `ERC721` pools) transferred to the claimer.
     *  @param  lpRedeemed Amount of `LP` exchanged for quote token (`WAD` precision).
     */
    event RemoveCollateral(
        address indexed claimer,
        uint256 indexed index,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 lpRedeemed
    );

    /***********************/
    /*** Borrower events ***/
    /***********************/

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when borrower repays quote tokens to the pool and/or pulls collateral from the pool.
     *  @param  borrower         `msg.sender` or on behalf of sender.
     *  @param  quoteRepaid      Amount of quote tokens repaid to the pool (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  collateralPulled The amount of collateral (`WAD` precision for `ERC20` pools, number of `NFT` tokens for `ERC721` pools) transferred to the claimer.
     *  @param  lup              `LUP` after repay.
     */
    event RepayDebt(
        address indexed borrower,
        uint256 quoteRepaid,
        uint256 collateralPulled,
        uint256 lup
    );

    /**********************/
    /*** Auction events ***/
    /**********************/

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when a liquidation is initiated.
     *  @param  borrower   Identifies the loan being liquidated.
     *  @param  debt       Debt the liquidation will attempt to cover (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  collateral Amount of collateral up for liquidation (`WAD` precision for `ERC20` pools, number of `NFT` tokens for `ERC721` pools).
     *  @param  bond       Bond amount locked by kicker (`WAD` precision).
     */
    event Kick(
        address indexed borrower,
        uint256 debt,
        uint256 collateral,
        uint256 bond
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when kickers are withdrawing funds posted as auction bonds.
     *  @param  kicker   The kicker withdrawing bonds.
     *  @param  reciever The address receiving withdrawn bond amount.
     *  @param  amount   The bond amount that was withdrawn (`WAD` precision).
     */
    event BondWithdrawn(
        address indexed kicker,
        address indexed reciever,
        uint256 amount
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when an actor uses quote token to arb higher-priced deposit off the book.
     *  @param  borrower    Identifies the loan being liquidated.
     *  @param  index       The index of the `Highest Price Bucket` used for this take.
     *  @param  amount      Amount of quote token used to purchase collateral (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  collateral  Amount of collateral purchased with quote token (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  bondChange  Impact of this take to the liquidation bond (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  isReward    `True` if kicker was rewarded with `bondChange` amount, `false` if kicker was penalized.
     *  @dev    amount / collateral implies the auction price.
     */
    event BucketTake(
        address indexed borrower,
        uint256 index,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 collateral,
        uint256 bondChange,
        bool    isReward
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when `LP` are awarded to a taker or kicker in a bucket take.
     *  @param  taker           Actor who invoked the bucket take.
     *  @param  kicker          Actor who started the auction.
     *  @param  lpAwardedTaker  Amount of `LP` awarded to the taker (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  lpAwardedKicker Amount of `LP` awarded to the actor who started the auction (`WAD` precision).
     */
    event BucketTakeLPAwarded(
        address indexed taker,
        address indexed kicker,
        uint256 lpAwardedTaker,
        uint256 lpAwardedKicker
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when an actor uses quote token outside of the book to purchase collateral under liquidation.
     *  @param  borrower   Identifies the loan being liquidated.
     *  @param  amount     Amount of quote token used to purchase collateral (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  collateral Amount of collateral purchased with quote token (for `ERC20` pool, `WAD` precision) or number of `NFT`s purchased (for `ERC721` pool).
     *  @param  bondChange Impact of this take to the liquidation bond (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  isReward   `True` if kicker was rewarded with `bondChange` amount, `false` if kicker was penalized.
     *  @dev    amount / collateral implies the auction price.
     */
    event Take(
        address indexed borrower,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 collateral,
        uint256 bondChange,
        bool    isReward
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when an actor settles debt in a completed liquidation
     *  @param  borrower    Identifies the loan under liquidation.
     *  @param  settledDebt Amount of pool debt settled in this transaction (`WAD` precision).
     *  @dev    When `amountRemaining_ == 0`, the auction has been completed cleared and removed from the queue.
     */
    event Settle(
        address indexed borrower,
        uint256 settledDebt
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when auction is completed.
     *  @param  borrower   Address of borrower that exits auction.
     *  @param  collateral Borrower's remaining collateral when auction completed (`WAD` precision).
     */
    event AuctionSettle(
        address indexed borrower,
        uint256 collateral
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when `NFT` auction is completed.
     *  @param  borrower   Address of borrower that exits auction.
     *  @param  collateral Borrower's remaining collateral when auction completed.
     *  @param  lp         Amount of `LP` given to the borrower to compensate fractional collateral (if any, `WAD` precision).
     *  @param  index      Index of the bucket with `LP` to compensate fractional collateral.
     */
    event AuctionNFTSettle(
        address indexed borrower,
        uint256 collateral,
        uint256 lp,
        uint256 index
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when a `Claimaible Reserve Auction` is started.
     *  @param  claimableReservesRemaining Amount of claimable reserves which has not yet been taken (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  auctionPrice               Current price at which `1` quote token may be purchased, denominated in `Ajna`.
     *  @param  currentBurnEpoch           Current burn epoch.
     */
    event KickReserveAuction(
        uint256 claimableReservesRemaining,
        uint256 auctionPrice,
        uint256 currentBurnEpoch
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when a `Claimaible Reserve Auction` is taken.
     *  @param  claimableReservesRemaining Amount of claimable reserves which has not yet been taken (`WAD` precision).
     *  @param  auctionPrice               Current price at which `1` quote token may be purchased, denominated in `Ajna`.
     *  @param  currentBurnEpoch           Current burn epoch.
     */
    event ReserveAuction(
        uint256 claimableReservesRemaining,
        uint256 auctionPrice,
        uint256 currentBurnEpoch
    );

    /**************************/
    /*** LP transfer events ***/
    /**************************/

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when owner increase the `LP` allowance of a spender at specified indexes with specified amounts.
     *  @param  owner     `LP` owner.
     *  @param  spender   Address approved to transfer `LP`.
     *  @param  indexes   Bucket indexes of `LP` approved.
     *  @param  amounts   `LP` amounts added (ordered by indexes, `WAD` precision).
     */
    event IncreaseLPAllowance(
        address indexed owner,
        address indexed spender,
        uint256[] indexes,
        uint256[] amounts
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when owner decrease the `LP` allowance of a spender at specified indexes with specified amounts.
     *  @param  owner     `LP` owner.
     *  @param  spender   Address approved to transfer `LP`.
     *  @param  indexes   Bucket indexes of `LP` approved.
     *  @param  amounts   `LP` amounts removed (ordered by indexes, `WAD` precision).
     */
    event DecreaseLPAllowance(
        address indexed owner,
        address indexed spender,
        uint256[] indexes,
        uint256[] amounts
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when lender removes the allowance of a spender for their `LP`.
     *  @param  owner   `LP` owner.
     *  @param  spender Address that is having it's allowance revoked.
     *  @param  indexes List of bucket index to remove the allowance from.
     */
    event RevokeLPAllowance(
        address indexed owner,
        address indexed spender,
        uint256[] indexes
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when lender whitelists addresses to accept `LP` from.
     *  @param  lender      Recipient that approves new owner for `LP`.
     *  @param  transferors List of addresses that can transfer `LP` to lender.
     */
    event ApproveLPTransferors(
        address indexed lender,
        address[] transferors
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when lender removes addresses from the `LP` transferors whitelist.
     *  @param  lender      Recipient that approves new owner for `LP`.
     *  @param  transferors List of addresses that won't be able to transfer `LP` to lender anymore.
     */
    event RevokeLPTransferors(
        address indexed lender,
        address[] transferors
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when a lender transfers their `LP` to a different address.
     *  @dev    Used by `PositionManager.memorializePositions()`.
     *  @param  owner    The original owner address of the position.
     *  @param  newOwner The new owner address of the position.
     *  @param  indexes  Array of price bucket indexes at which `LP` were transferred.
     *  @param  lp       Amount of `LP` transferred (`WAD` precision).
     */
    event TransferLP(
        address owner,
        address newOwner,
        uint256[] indexes,
        uint256 lp
    );

    /**************************/
    /*** Pool common events ***/
    /**************************/

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when `LP` are forfeited as a result of the bucket losing all assets.
     *  @param  index       The index of the bucket.
     *  @param  lpForfeited Amount of `LP` forfeited by lenders (`WAD` precision).
     */
    event BucketBankruptcy(
        uint256 indexed index,
        uint256 lpForfeited
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when a flashloan is taken from pool.
     *  @param  receiver The address receiving the flashloan.
     *  @param  token    The address of token flashloaned from pool.
     *  @param  amount   The amount of tokens flashloaned from pool (token precision).
     */
    event Flashloan(
        address indexed receiver,
        address indexed token,
        uint256 amount
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when a loan `Np to Tp ratio` is restamped.
     *  @param  borrower Identifies the loan to update the `Np to Tp ratio`.
     */
    event LoanStamped(
        address indexed borrower
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when pool interest rate is reset. This happens when `interest rate > 10%` and `debtEma < 5%` of `depositEma`
     *  @param  oldRate Old pool interest rate.
     *  @param  newRate New pool interest rate.
     */
    event ResetInterestRate(
        uint256 oldRate,
        uint256 newRate
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when pool interest rate is updated.
     *  @param  oldRate Old pool interest rate.
     *  @param  newRate New pool interest rate.
     */
    event UpdateInterestRate(
        uint256 oldRate,
        uint256 newRate
    );

    /**
     *  @notice Emitted when interest accural or update interest overflows.
     */
    event InterestUpdateFailure();

}

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/**
 * @title IL2Pool
 * @author Aave
 * @notice Defines the basic extension interface for an L2 Aave Pool.
 */
interface IL2Pool {
  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the supply function on behalf of the caller
   * @param args Arguments for the supply function packed in one bytes32
   *    96 bits       16 bits         128 bits      16 bits
   * | 0-padding | referralCode | shortenedAmount | assetId |
   * @dev the shortenedAmount is cast to 256 bits at decode time, if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to
   * type(uint256).max
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   */
  function supply(bytes32 args) external;

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the supplyWithPermit function on behalf of the caller
   * @param args Arguments for the supply function packed in one bytes32
   *    56 bits    8 bits         32 bits           16 bits         128 bits      16 bits
   * | 0-padding | permitV | shortenedDeadline | referralCode | shortenedAmount | assetId |
   * @dev the shortenedAmount is cast to 256 bits at decode time, if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to
   * type(uint256).max
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   * @param r The R parameter of ERC712 permit sig
   * @param s The S parameter of ERC712 permit sig
   */
  function supplyWithPermit(bytes32 args, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external;

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the withdraw function, withdrawing to the caller
   * @param args Arguments for the withdraw function packed in one bytes32
   *    112 bits       128 bits      16 bits
   * | 0-padding | shortenedAmount | assetId |
   * @dev the shortenedAmount is cast to 256 bits at decode time, if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to
   * type(uint256).max
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   * @return The final amount withdrawn
   */
  function withdraw(bytes32 args) external returns (uint256);

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the borrow function, borrowing on behalf of the caller
   * @param args Arguments for the borrow function packed in one bytes32
   *    88 bits       16 bits             8 bits                 128 bits       16 bits
   * | 0-padding | referralCode | shortenedInterestRateMode | shortenedAmount | assetId |
   * @dev the shortenedAmount is cast to 256 bits at decode time, if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to
   * type(uint256).max
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   */
  function borrow(bytes32 args) external;

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the repay function, repaying on behalf of the caller
   * @param args Arguments for the repay function packed in one bytes32
   *    104 bits             8 bits               128 bits       16 bits
   * | 0-padding | shortenedInterestRateMode | shortenedAmount | assetId |
   * @dev the shortenedAmount is cast to 256 bits at decode time, if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to
   * type(uint256).max
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   * @return The final amount repaid
   */
  function repay(bytes32 args) external returns (uint256);

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the repayWithPermit function, repaying on behalf of the caller
   * @param args Arguments for the repayWithPermit function packed in one bytes32
   *    64 bits    8 bits        32 bits                   8 bits               128 bits       16 bits
   * | 0-padding | permitV | shortenedDeadline | shortenedInterestRateMode | shortenedAmount | assetId |
   * @dev the shortenedAmount is cast to 256 bits at decode time, if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to
   * type(uint256).max
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   * @param r The R parameter of ERC712 permit sig
   * @param s The S parameter of ERC712 permit sig
   * @return The final amount repaid
   */
  function repayWithPermit(bytes32 args, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external returns (uint256);

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the repayWithATokens function
   * @param args Arguments for the repayWithATokens function packed in one bytes32
   *    104 bits             8 bits               128 bits       16 bits
   * | 0-padding | shortenedInterestRateMode | shortenedAmount | assetId |
   * @dev the shortenedAmount is cast to 256 bits at decode time, if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to
   * type(uint256).max
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   * @return The final amount repaid
   */
  function repayWithATokens(bytes32 args) external returns (uint256);

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the setUserUseReserveAsCollateral function
   * @param args Arguments for the setUserUseReserveAsCollateral function packed in one bytes32
   *    239 bits         1 bit       16 bits
   * | 0-padding | useAsCollateral | assetId |
   * @dev assetId is the index of the asset in the reservesList.
   */
  function setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(bytes32 args) external;

  /**
   * @notice Calldata efficient wrapper of the liquidationCall function
   * @param args1 part of the arguments for the liquidationCall function packed in one bytes32
   *    64 bits      160 bits       16 bits         16 bits
   * | 0-padding | user address | debtAssetId | collateralAssetId |
   * @param args2 part of the arguments for the liquidationCall function packed in one bytes32
   *    127 bits       1 bit             128 bits
   * | 0-padding | receiveAToken | shortenedDebtToCover |
   * @dev the shortenedDebtToCover is cast to 256 bits at decode time,
   * if type(uint128).max the value will be expanded to type(uint256).max
   */
  function liquidationCall(bytes32 args1, bytes32 args2) external;
}
